entities.summary: The Costa Rica National Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in La Sabana Metropolitan Park, San José, Costa Rica. It was the first modern sporting and events arena to be built in Central America. The stadium was completed in early 2011 and officially opened its doors to the public on March 26 of that year, with a capacity of 42.000 seats. The stadium replaced the original National Stadium, and is the home stadium of the Costa Rican national football team.
